boundaries.name: canonical_abi_and_storage
boundaries.obligation: Nat arguments/observations stand for canonical typed Solidity ABI values and reachable storage projection; generated ABI getters, physical slot layout and decoder failures require separate semantics.

boundaries.name: deployment_environment_link
boundaries.obligation: Constructor validation is modeled, but returned Deployment must be linked to later Environment's immutable deployer/chain/adapters/treasury and code addresses; arbitrary environment replacement is not a valid deployment execution.

boundaries.name: external_call_and_staticcall_semantics
boundaries.obligation: Each stateful dependency receives exact pre-call State and typed target/arguments and can return callback-mutated storage. STATICCALL restrictions, getter/core ABI decoding, low160 assembly address cleanup and EVM call/return behavior are not proved.

boundaries.name: safe_erc20_and_actual_custody
boundaries.obligation: Token acceptance, truthful balance observations, native actual balance and transfer of stake/msg.value are not proved from logical escrow/pending entries.

boundaries.name: callback_storage_frames
boundaries.obligation: Rollback preservation is conditional on the explicit local RollbackCallbackFrame. Other stateful callbacks remain arbitrary. This frame must be discharged against satellite/public-call semantics, not assumed as global protocol safety.

boundaries.name: outer_transaction_atomicity
boundaries.obligation: commit models all-or-nothing projected storage/own logs. Nested materializer, token, callback and global EVM rollback requires independent proof; success shape does not establish full-transaction physical conservation.

boundaries.name: rollup_own_event_projection
boundaries.obligation: Exact Rollup-owned event fields/order are represented on final success, but callee logs/global callback-relative event interleaving and events discarded by outer failure are not an EVM trace extraction. withdrawToken's event precedes its calls in source.

boundaries.name: hash_abi_memory_and_storage_layout
boundaries.obligation: Concrete BE hashPreimage/wordBytes are executable, and key widths have named proofs. HashEncodingAgrees with actual Keccak, assembly pointer/copy/storage layout and compiler lowering remains undischarged; no cryptographic injectivity is assumed by local accounting.

boundaries.name: compact_proof_and_da_soundness
boundaries.obligation: Validity/withdrawal adapter returns, fraud verdict meaning and Blob exactbyte attestation depend on separately verified code/circuits/configuration/crypto and deployed identities. Guards alone do not establish proof or DA soundness.

boundaries.name: generic_private_assembly_domains
boundaries.obligation: Eight-limb helpers and close-member assembly are represented on actual guarded caller domains. Generic malformed offsets/counts/raw calldata physical overread and wraparound-sized memory copies outside those domains are not proved equivalent to the total projection.

boundaries.name: self_call_gas_and_abi
boundaries.obligation: finalize evaluates actual fullVerify code and catches modeled errors, but source this.fullVerify STATICCALL ABI/resource exceptional behavior and first-selector encoding correspondence are not proved.

boundaries.name: fraud_gas_calibration
boundaries.obligation: encodedMleVerdict represents separate source gas observations and budget/catch classifications, not EVM gas accounting or a calibrated25m proof of availability; unknown ABI verdicts are supplied only after a valid uint8 decode.

boundaries.name: pooled_escrow_and_temporal_scope
boundaries.obligation: All source function families have control-flow models, but all-entrypoint temporal closure and physical custody/source refinement remain unproved. FinalityRecoveryTrace composes only actual finalize and rollbackBatch receipts. Posting/truncation/all-callback closure and channel-level entitlement are not inferred from pooled per-token ceilings.

boundaries.name: resource_and_compiler_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Gas/memory exhaustion, arbitrary-size allocations, compiler behavior and EVM small-step semantics are not proved. A full-source line partition and zero untranslated top-level function families are inventories, not whole-source proof coverage.
